params.description: A unique key used to identify an entire super trip which incorporates all inclusive bookings (i.e. Cars, Hotels, other Flights). The key can be used to search and price flights again and place them into the same super trip.

items.docs: When a trip is to be booked, send a request to the endpoint /book/ to create the Universal Record and associated PNR's for the trip. The booking can then be placed on the agency's ticketing queue.
To cancel a booking, send a request with the trip_id and ur_locator_code.
If a trip has been booked, but not yet added to the agency ticketing queue, use this endpoint to add it to their queue.
If a trip has been queued, but not yet ticketed, use this endpoint to do the ticketing.
